messages:
maggie: FYI eu-west3 started seeing GPU attach holds this morning. kube logs: 'attach held: disk iops exceeded threshold'.

maggie: quick host sample: nvme %util peaked at 100% while several model prewarm downloads ran concurrently. small dmesg I/O timeout messages but no SMART fail.

raj: did we change prewarm parallelism?

sam: yes, we bumped replicas + parallel fetch last week to speed up cold starts.

izzy: short-term: scale prewarm down to 2 per node and set PREWARM_PARALLELISM=1. avoid scheduling warmups during janitor scrub window (02:00-04:00 UTC).

maggie: scaling now. ops-bot will do canary.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by maggie:reduce-warmup-concurrency -> rollout started (canary 25%).

raj: medium-term ideas: per-node token-bucket for warmup pulls or blkio cgroup limits for prewarm worker so it can’t starve system IO. PoC would be a lightweight sidecar that tracks tokens.

sam: also need cost tradeoff: lower prewarm -> higher cold-start p95 -> maybe more reserved GPUs for hot models. I'll do a quick delta.

izzy: add alert: nvme_util > 85% AND gpu_attach_errors > 1/min to page SRE. dashboard tile for prewarm concurrency by node would help.

maggie: canary looks healthy so far, attach errors dropping from ~3.8% -> 0.9% in eu-west3.

raj: I'll start a PoC token-bucket sidecar and a K8s admission enforcer. aim for PoC in 7 days.

sam: i'll post reserved-pool cost numbers tomorrow.

maggie: filing a short incident note and linking this thread if it recurs. :thumbsup:
